passages.quote:
This guidance summarises the changes that are taking place to the UK’s trade mark legislation and how they will affect rights holders, allowing businesses time to prepare.

The changes that are taking place relate to the following areas:

applying for a trade mark

objecting, challenging and resolving trade mark disputes

managing trade marks
